newsitem.title: GERMANY: German sugar beet harvest stays ahead of last year.
newsitem.headline: German sugar beet harvest stays ahead of last year.

text.p: German sugar beet deliveries to refineries as of October 11 were 6.36 million tonnes, up from 5.66 million last year, the sugar industry association WVZ said on Tuesday in its third report of the 1996/97 campaign.
Sugar content at delivery on October 11 was 17.76 percent, up from 16.45 percent a year earlier.
WVZ maintained its forecast for final deliveries of 26.43 million tonnes, up from a final 26.05 million in 1995/96.
WVZ will run delivery updates from now until the end of the campaign in January on a weekly basis.

Deliveries to refineries up to October 4 were 4.03 million tonnes versus 3.27 million recorded at the same time last year, and sugar content on that day was 17.64 percent, up from 16.29 percent previously.
